move.desc: A crushing blow that also steadies you behind a stone guard.

yellow_dragon_earth_sovereign.lore: The Yellow Dragon keeps the centre, where all the elements meet and none of them move it.

grounded_stance.name: Grounded Stance
grounded_stance.lore: Stand for an hour in the horse stance, every morning, for ten years.

stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
stone_skin.lore: Grey and rough, and blades slide off it.

bedrock_will.name: Bedrock Will
bedrock_will.lore: Below the soil, below the stone, there is the thing that does not move.

mountain_heart.name: Mountain Heart
mountain_heart.lore: The mountain does not fight. It is simply still there afterwards.

dust_ring_haymaker.name: Dust Ring Haymaker

move.desc: A wide, heavy swing that the Dust Ring crowd loves.

dust_ring_haymaker.lore: Nobody in the Dust Ring has ever blocked it. Most of them never saw it coming either.

iron_bell_toll.name: Iron Bell Toll

move.desc: A palm struck like a temple bell; the ringing dazes the enemy.

iron_bell_toll.lore: The Master of the Iron Bell rings it once at the start of every bout, and once at the end.

jade_terrace_sweep.name: Jade Terrace Sweep

move.desc: A low sweep across the terrace that knocks the guard aside.

jade_terrace_sweep.lore: The Lord of the Jade Terrace sweeps the floor with their challengers, as the saying goes.

golden_pit_fury.name: Golden Pit Fury

move.desc: Three furious burning blows in the style of the pit.

golden_pit_fury.lore: The Sovereign of the Golden Pit fights like the pit is on fire. It usually is.

soul_lotus_bloom.name: Soul Lotus Bloom

move.desc: A lotus of soul-light that drinks from the enemy and binds them.

soul_lotus_bloom.lore: The Keeper of the Soul Lotus does not strike. The lotus does.

move.desc: Tooth and claw.
